ipb-action-request-import: The label for the action select option on [[Special:Block]] to block a user from requesting import dumps.
requestimport-apierror-chunking-disabled: API error shown when action=requestimportupload is used while $wgRequestImportEnableChunkedUploads is false.
requestimport-apierror-type-mismatch: API error shown when a chunk of a chunked upload uses a different type parameter than the first chunk.
requestimport-archive-binary-unavailable: Error shown when an uploaded archive needs a program that is not set up in $wgRequestImportExternalBinaries, or that could not be run.
requestimport-archive-bzip2-unavailable: Error shown when an uploaded BZIP2 file cannot be read because the bz2 PHP extension is not installed.
requestimport-archive-empty: Error shown when an uploaded archive does not contain any files.
requestimport-archive-memory:
Error shown when a 7z archive was made with settings that need more memory to unpack than $wgRequestImportExternalBinaries allows.

Parameters:
* $1 - The most memory that is allowed, as a size such as "1 GB".
requestimport-archive-mixed: Error shown when an uploaded archive has more than one file and one of them is not an XML file.
requestimport-archive-ratio: Error shown when an uploaded archive expands far more than a normal file would.
requestimport-archive-too-large: Error shown when an uploaded archive expands to more than the allowed size. $1 is the allowed size.
requestimport-archive-too-many-entries: Error shown when an uploaded archive has too many entries. $1 is the number of entries that are allowed.
requestimport-archive-unreadable: Error shown when an uploaded archive could not be opened or extracted, or is damaged.
requestimport-archive-unsafe: Error shown when an uploaded archive contains an encrypted file, a link, a special file or a file with an unsafe name.
requestimport-button-copy: Text for the 'Copy to Clipboard' button.
requestimport-chunkedupload-error:
Error shown on [[Special:RequestImport]] when a chunked upload fails. Parameters:
* $1 - the error message returned by the API
requestimport-chunkedupload-progress: Status text shown under the progress bar on [[Special:RequestImport]] while a large file is uploaded in chunks.
requestimport-comment-success: Message displayed when a comment is successfully added to the request.
requestimport-duplicate-comment: Message displayed when the user attempts to resubmit the same comment as the their previous request.
requestimport-duplicate-request: Message displayed when user attempts to submit a request that is to similar to an existing open request.
requestimport-edit-success: Message displayed when the request is successfully edited.
requestimport-help-overwrite: Help for the 'overwrite' checkbox, shown to those who handle requests for images.
requestimport-help-skip-dupes: Help for the 'skip duplicates' checkbox, shown for requests that have images.
requestimport-help-upload-either: Help shown above the file fields of Special:RequestImport when images can also be uploaded. At least one of the XML file and the images is needed.
requestimport-help-upload-images: Help for the 'Upload images' field on the form of Special:RequestImport.
requestimport-help-upload-xml: Help for the 'Upload File' field. It is followed by {{msg-mw|requestimport-help-upload-file-types}} and, if the check for the full revision history is turned on, {{msg-mw|requestimport-help-upload-file-history}}.
requestimport-help-upload-xml-history: Help for the 'Upload File' field, shown after {{msg-mw|requestimport-help-upload-file-types}}. It is only shown when the wiki checks whether an uploaded dump has the full revision history.
requestimport-help-upload-xml-types:
Help for the 'Upload File' field, shown after {{msg-mw|requestimport-help-upload-file}}. The archive types depend on what the wiki has set up.

Parameters:
* $1 - A list of the archive types that can be uploaded, such as "ZIP, TAR, GZIP and BZIP2".
* $2 - A list of file extensions that a compressed TAR file can have, such as ".tar.gz, .tgz and .tar.bz2".
requestimport-images-comment:
Upload comment given to each file that is imported from an archive of images. It is used as wikitext.

Parameters:
* $1 - The URL of the source wiki.
* $2 - The URL of the request on the wiki that has the requests.
* $3 - The number of the request.
requestimport-images-comment-plain:
Upload comment given to each file that is imported from an archive of images, when the URL of the request is not known.

Parameters:
* $1 - The URL of the source wiki.
* $2 - The number of the request.
requestimport-images-empty: Error shown when an uploaded archive of images has no files in it.
requestimport-images-failed-comment: Comment given on request when an import of images receives an error.
requestimport-images-file-rejected:
Shown once for each file of an uploaded archive of images that cannot be imported, after {{msg-mw|requestimport-images-too-many-skipped}}, so that they can be fixed together. Up to ten are shown.

Parameters:
* $1 - The file name.
* $2 - The reason it was rejected, as a message.
requestimport-images-job-missing: Reason given when the job that imports images cannot find the stored files of the request.
requestimport-images-not-archive: Error shown when the file uploaded for the images is not an archive.
requestimport-images-parts-incomplete: Error shown when a request is submitted with an archive of images that was uploaded in parts, but not all of them were uploaded.
requestimport-images-skip-duplicate: Reason that a file of an uploaded archive of images is left out of the import. It is shown beside the file name.
requestimport-images-skip-extension:
Reason that a file of an uploaded archive of images is left out of the import. It is shown beside the file name.

Parameters:
* $1 - The extension of the file, without the dot.
requestimport-images-skip-name: Reason that a file of an uploaded archive of images is left out of the import. It is shown beside the file name.
requestimport-images-skip-no-extension: Reason that a file of an uploaded archive of images is left out of the import. It is shown beside the file name. The file has no extension and the type of its content has no extension that is allowed.
requestimport-images-skip-type:
Reason that a file of an uploaded archive of images is left out of the import. It is shown beside the file name.

Parameters:
* $1 - The MIME type of the content of the file, such as image/webp.
requestimport-images-too-many-skipped:
Error shown when an uploaded archive of images is rejected because too many of its files cannot be imported, or none can. The files follow it.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of files that cannot be imported.
* $2 - The number of files in the archive, not counting hidden ones.
requestimport-import-finished: Shown in place of the progress bar on a request when its import has finished.
requestimport-import-started: Message displayed when the import is successfully started.
requestimport-import-step:
Label above the progress bar on a request while it is being imported, when the progress of the stage is not known. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of the stage that is running
* $2 - the number of stages
* $3 - the name of the stage, such as {{msg-mw|requestimport-stage-import}}
requestimport-import-step-pages:
Label above the progress bar on a request while its pages are being imported. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of the stage that is running
* $2 - the number of stages
* $3 - the name of the stage, such as {{msg-mw|requestimport-stage-import}}
* $4 - the number of pages that are imported so far
* $5 - the number of pages in the file
* $6 - the percentage of the pages that is done
requestimport-import-step-percent:
Label above the progress bar on a request while it is being imported, when the progress of the stage is known. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of the stage that is running
* $2 - the number of stages
* $3 - the name of the stage, such as {{msg-mw|requestimport-stage-import}}
* $4 - the percentage of the stage that is done
requestimport-import-stopped: Shown in place of the progress bar on a request when its import is no longer running, for example because it failed or was declined.
requestimport-import-waiting: Label of the progress bar on a request before its import has started.
requestimport-info-already-imported: Notice shown on Special:RequestImportQueue to handlers when the pages were already imported but the job stopped later. $1 is the name of the step that it stopped at.
requestimport-info-command: The generated command that is displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue. $1 is the generated command.
requestimport-info-file-expired: Message shown on a request when its uploaded file no longer exists and the request is older than the retention period set in $wgRequestImportFileExpiryDays. $1 is the number of days; $2 is the lowercase status of the request.
requestimport-info-filesize: The file size for the uploaded XML file. $1 is the file size.
requestimport-info-groups:
User groups that the requester has on the target wiki. Displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue.
* $1 is the requester's username
* $2 is the target wiki's database name
* $3 is the comma-separated list of user groups
requestimport-info-history-full: Notice shown to handlers on a request when no missing revisions were found in the dump.
requestimport-info-history-partial: Warning shown to handlers on a request when the dump seems to be missing revisions.
requestimport-info-history-unknown: Notice shown to handlers on a request when it could not be checked whether the dump has the full revision history.
requestimport-info-interwiki: The information displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue, when there is no interwiki prefix present, and you have the necessary rights to insert a prefix. $1 is the target database name.
requestimport-info-linked-images:
Notice shown on a request for pages that was made together with a request for images.

Parameters:
* $1 - A link to the request for the images, such as #12.
* $2 - The status of that request in lowercase, such as pending.
requestimport-info-linked-xml:
Notice shown on a request for images that was made together with a request for pages.

Parameters:
* $1 - A link to the request for the pages, such as #12.
* $2 - The status of that request in lowercase, such as pending.
requestimport-info-missing-rights:
Notice shown when the requester is missing rights that are needed on the target wiki for this type of request.

Parameters:
* $1 - The requester's username.
* $2 - The target wiki's database name.
* $3 - The list of the missing rights.
* $4 - The number of missing rights, for plural.
requestimport-info-no-file-found: Message displayed instead of generated command and file size, if the file for the request is not found. $1 is the full path to the file.
requestimport-info-no-interwiki-prefix: Message that is displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue when no interwiki prefix is found on the target wiki, which is pointing to the source wiki. $1 is the target wiki; $2 is the source wiki's hostname.
requestimport-info-remaining-commands: Shown after {{msg-mw|requestimport-info-already-imported}}. $1 is a list of commands, one per line.
requestimport-info-request-private: Message that is displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue when viewing a request that is private.
requestimport-info-requester-blocked: Message that is displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue when the requester has been blocked on the current wiki. $1 is the requester's username; $2 is the current wiki's ID.
requestimport-info-requester-locked: Message that is displayed on the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue when the requester has been locked. $1 is the requester's username.
requestimport-info-skipped-files:
Warning shown on a request of image files when some of the files in the archive are left out of the import and the rest are imported.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of files that were left out.
* $2 - A list of the first few file names, which ends with {{msg-mw|requestimport-info-skipped-more}} if there are more.
requestimport-info-skipped-more:
Last item of the list of file names in {{msg-mw|requestimport-info-skipped-files}}, when there are more files than are named.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of files that are not named.
requestimport-info-skipped-show: Label that opens the list of all of the files that are left out of the import of an archive of images, and the reason for each.
requestimport-info-skipped-truncated:
Shown under the list of files that are left out of an import when the list is too long to be kept in full.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of files that are not in the list.
requestimport-info-target-missing: Error shown to handlers on a request when its target wiki has been deleted. $1 is the database name of the target wiki.
requestimport-info-verifying: Notice shown to handlers on a request while its uploaded file is being checked.
requestimport-interwiki-failed: Error message displayed when submitting the interwiki table changes fails. $1 is the target database name.
requestimport-interwiki-success: Success message displayed when submitting the interwiki table changes successfully. $1 is the target database name.
requestimport-invalid-interwiki-url: Status message displayed when invalid URL was entered for the 'url' field for adding interwiki.
requestimport-invalid-target: Status message displayed when invalid database name was entered for the 'target' field.
requestimport-label-add-comment: Label for the 'Add Comment' submit button.
requestimport-label-decline-import: Label for the 'Decline Import' submit button.
requestimport-label-edit-request: Label for the 'Edit Request' submit button.
requestimport-label-interwiki-prefix: Label for the interwiki prefix field.
requestimport-label-interwiki-url: Label for the interwiki URL field. $1 is an example URL that can be entered here. It is displayed as <scheme>://<host>/wiki/$1. The scheme and host are populated by parsing the source URL for the request.
requestimport-label-overwrite: Label for the 'overwrite' checkbox, shown to those who handle requests for images.
requestimport-label-partial: 'Partially completed' status label. Used when the pages were imported but a later step failed.
requestimport-label-recheck-skipped: Label for the submit button that checks the files that were skipped because of their file type again. It is shown to handlers on a pending request of images.
requestimport-label-resume-import: Label for the submit button that continues an import that already imported its pages.
requestimport-label-retry-verification: Label for the submit button that queues the check of an uploaded file again. It is shown to handlers while a request is being checked.
requestimport-label-skip-dupes: Label for the 'skip duplicates' checkbox, shown for requests that have images.
requestimport-label-stage: Label for the import stage that is shown on a request.
requestimport-label-start-import: Label for the 'Start Import' submit button.
requestimport-label-status-updated-comme: Label for the optional comment field in the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-label-update-status: Label for the update status select field in the 'handling' section of Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-label-upload-xml: Label for the XML file field of Special:RequestImport when images can also be uploaded.
requestimport-label-verifying: 'Verifying' status label. Used while the uploaded file of a request is being checked.
requestimport-no-changes: Message displayed if attempting to edit request without making any changes.
requestimport-notcentral:
Heading for the message displayed if there is a configured central wiki, and it is not the current wiki.
{{Identical|Disabled}}
requestimport-notcentral-text: Text for the message displayed if there is a configured central wiki, and it is not the current wiki.
requestimport-notification-body-import-f: Echo notification body for 'requestimport-import-failed'. $1 is the error message that is received.
requestimport-notification-body-new-requ: Echo notification body for 'requestimport-new-request'. $1 is reason; $2 is the requester's username; $3 is the target wiki's database name.
requestimport-notification-header-attent: Echo notification header for 'requestimport-attention'. $1 is the request ID.
requestimport-notification-header-commen: Echo notification header for 'requestimport-request-comment'. $1 is the request ID.
requestimport-notification-header-import: Echo notification header for 'requestimport-import-failed'. $1 is the request ID.
requestimport-notification-header-new-re: Echo notification header for 'requestimport-new-request'. $1 is the request ID.
requestimport-notification-header-status: Echo notification header for 'requestimport-request-status-update'. $1 is the request ID.
requestimport-notloggedin: Error message if user tries to request an import dump while not being logged in.
requestimport-output-empty: Shown in the script output tab of a request when the script has printed nothing yet, or when the output is no longer kept.
requestimport-private: Error message if a user tries to view an import dump request that is marked as private and they do not have access to it.
requestimport-recheck-not-needed: Error shown to handlers when they try to check skipped files again, but there are none that are kept, or the request is not pending.
requestimport-recheck-queued: Success message shown to handlers after the check of the skipped files was queued.
requestimport-request-edited: 'Request edited' message. $1 is the actor's username; $2 is the changes that were made.
requestimport-request-edited-reason: Message displayed if the value of 'reason' was edited. $1 is the previous value; $2 is the new value.
requestimport-request-edited-skip-dupes: Message displayed if the 'skip duplicates' choice was edited. $1 is the previous value; $2 is the new value.
requestimport-request-edited-source: Message displayed if the value of 'source' was edited. $1 is the previous value; $2 is the new value.
requestimport-request-edited-target: Message displayed if the value of 'target' was edited. $1 is the previous value; $2 is the new value.
requestimport-request-locked: Message displayed above the form at Special:RequestImportQueue if the request is locked.
requestimport-request-reopened: 'Request reopened' message. $1 is the actor's username; $2 is the changes that were made.
requestimport-requestimportqueue-notcent:
Heading for the message displayed for Special:RequestImportQueue if there is a configured central wiki, and it is not the current wiki.
{{Identical|Disabled}}
Text for the message displayed for Special:RequestImportQueue if there is a configured central wiki, and it is not the current wiki.
requestimport-requirement-blocked:
Error shown to handlers when they try to start an import that the target wiki is certain to reject. Parameters:
* $1 - the list of the extensions that are missing or that have a setting turned off
requestimport-requirement-missing:
Error shown to handlers, and to requesters who can read the target wiki, when the dump needs extensions that the target wiki does not have. Parameters:
* $1 - the list of the names of the extensions
* $2 - the number of extensions
requestimport-requirement-setting:
Error shown to handlers, and to requesters who can read the target wiki, when the dump needs settings of extensions that are turned off on the target wiki. Parameters:
* $1 - the list of the names of the settings, each with the extension that it belongs to in brackets
* $2 - the number of settings
requestimport-requirement-setting-unknow:
Warning shown to handlers, and to requesters who can read the target wiki, when the dump needs settings of extensions and it is not known whether the target wiki has them enabled. Parameters:
* $1 - the list of the names of the settings, each with the extension that it belongs to in brackets
* $2 - the number of settings
requestimport-requirement-unknown:
Warning shown to handlers, and to requesters who can read the target wiki, when the dump needs extensions and it is not known whether the target wiki has them enabled. Parameters:
* $1 - the list of the names of the extensions
* $2 - the number of extensions
requestimport-section-comments:
'Request Comments' section label.
{{doc-important|This means "comments about the request", not "ask for comments"}}
requestimport-section-details:
'Request Details' section label.
{{doc-important|This means "details about the request", not "ask for details"}}
requestimport-section-output: 'Script output' section label. It shows what the script that imports the files printed, and is only shown to handlers.
requestimport-stage-afterimport: Stage name for running the hooks that run after an import.
requestimport-stage-counts: Stage name for updating edit counts and the article count after an import.
requestimport-stage-download: Stage name for fetching the XML file before it is imported.
requestimport-stage-images: Name of the stage of a request for images while its files are being imported.
requestimport-stage-import: Stage name for importing the pages from the XML file.
requestimport-stage-recentchanges: Stage name for rebuilding recent changes after an import.
requestimport-stage-refreshlinks: Stage name for refreshing the links tables after an import.
requestimport-stage-sitestats: Stage name for updating the site statistics after an import.
requestimport-stage-textindex: Stage name for rebuilding the search index after an import.
requestimport-status-comment-given: Displayed after the status update message if the handler also gave a comment, which follows this text.
requestimport-status-conflict: Error message displayed if a conflict is detected when starting or declining an import. There is a conflict if the status is already 'complete', 'inprogress', or 'starting'.
requestimport-status-updated: Fixed comment given to requester when the status is updated. $1 is status.
requestimport-status-updated-by: Fixed comment given to requester when the status is updated by a user. $1 is status; $2 is the username of the user who updated it.
requestimport-status-updated-success: Message displayed when the status of the request is successfully updated.
requestimport-success: Message after an import dump request has been successfully submitted.
requestimport-success-both:
Message after a request and a request for its images have been successfully submitted together.

Parameters:
* $1 - A link to the request, such as #12.
* $2 - A link to the request for the images, such as #13.
requestimport-success-locked: Message displayed when a request has been successfully locked.
requestimport-success-overwrite: Message displayed when a request has been set to replace the files that already exist on the wiki.
requestimport-success-private: Message displayed when a request has been successfully marked as private.
requestimport-success-public: Message displayed when a request has been successfully marked as public.
requestimport-success-skip: Message displayed when a request has been set to skip the files that already exist on the wiki.
requestimport-success-unlocked: Message displayed when a request has been successfully unlocked.
requestimport-success-verifying:
Notice shown after submitting files that are checked in the background.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of files that are checked, for plural.
requestimport-table-requested-date: 'Requested Date' label for the table on Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-table-requester: 'Requester' label for the table on Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-table-status: 'Status' label for the table on Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-table-target: 'Target' label for the table on Special:RequestImportQueue.
requestimport-unknown: Message displayed if the request is not found.
requestimport-upload-nothing: Error shown when the form of Special:RequestImport is sent without an XML file and without images.
requestimport-usergroups-none: Displayed value if the requester has no user groups on the target wiki.
requestimport-verification-checking: Label of the progress bar on a request while the XML of its uploaded file is checked.
requestimport-verification-done: Shown in place of the progress bar on a request when the check of its uploaded file has passed.
requestimport-verification-extracting: Label of the progress bar on a request while its uploaded archive is extracted.
requestimport-verification-failed: Comment added to a request, which is also declined, when the uploaded file is rejected by the check. $1 is the reason.
requestimport-verification-joining: Progress label while the parts of an uploaded archive of images are joined into one file. Shown with a percentage.
requestimport-verification-merging: Label of the progress bar on a request while the XML files of its uploaded archive are merged into one.
requestimport-verification-not-needed: Error shown to handlers when they try to retry the check of a request that is not being checked.
requestimport-verification-rejected: Shown in place of the progress bar on a request when its uploaded file was rejected by the check.
requestimport-verification-reload: Text of the link that is shown after the check of an uploaded file is done. It reloads the request page.
requestimport-verification-retried: Success message shown to handlers after the check of an uploaded file was queued again.
requestimport-verification-storing: Progress label while the extracted image files are stored. Shown with a percentage.
requestimport-verification-waiting: Label of the progress bar on a request before the check of its uploaded file has started.
requestimport-verify-missing: Reason given when the file that should be checked was not found in the file repository.
requestimport-verifying-conflict: Error shown to handlers when they try to handle a request whose uploaded file is still being checked.
requestimport-xml-doctype: Error shown when an uploaded XML file has a DOCTYPE.
requestimport-xml-failed-comment: Comment given on request when an import receives an error
requestimport-xml-invalid: Error shown when an uploaded XML file is not well-formed.
requestimport-xml-no-pages: Error shown when an uploaded XML file is an export without any pages.
requestimport-xml-not-dump: Error shown when an uploaded file is not a MediaWiki XML export.
requestimport-xml-partial-comment: Comment given on request when the import completed but a later step, such as a maintenance script, received an error.
requestimport-xml-parts-incomplete: Error shown when a request is submitted with an XML file that was uploaded in parts, but not all of them were uploaded.
requestimport-xml-version-mismatch: Error shown when the XML files in an archive were not made with the same version of the export format, so they cannot be merged.
requestimportprivate-log-header: Header for the RequestImport private log.
